versions.subject: Create at_command.yml
versions.detection:
keywords:
    - at|contains:
      - '* at *'
    - atd|contains:
      - '* atd *'
    - enumeration|contains:
      - 'which atd'
      - 'which at'
      - 'systemctl status atd'
      - 'service atd status '
condition: keywords
versions.spl: at="* at *" OR atd="* atd *" OR enumeration IN ("*which atd*", "*which at*", "*systemctl status atd*", "*service atd status *")
